entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3909745223886018432: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.0918 +/- 0.0179 mas (same row, RUWE 1.10): 141.01 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -77.282, 11.291 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.935 +/- 0.023 solar radii from Močnik et al. 2016, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-85 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....151..150M/abstract). Mass 1.09 +/- 0.08 solar masses from Močnik et al. 2016, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-85 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....151..150M/abstract). Temperature 6112 +/- 27 K from Močnik et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-85 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 6,112 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fff5f4. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,112 K and log g 4.53 (u1 0.398, u2 0.295): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
